## What session 7 is for {.scrollable}
::::: columns

:::: {.column width="33%"}

### The mathematics

- State each paper's **research question** and choose the simple model that answers it
- Read every result as a sentence, in units, and say what it does **not** license
- Say how a simple model differs from the paper's own design, and why the numbers differ

::::

:::: {.column width="33%"}

### The Python

- Load an authors' data file — `.dta`, `.xlsx`, `.csv` — into pandas
- Fit OLS, the three logits, ridge, the lasso and the elastic net with **only the code seen in class**
- Run a whole analysis as one script in VS Codium, step by step

::::

:::: {.column width="33%"}

### The international business

- Read five international-business papers as claims to be checked
- Explain a result to someone who will not read the code
- Keep a log a referee could follow

::::

:::::

## What to do, and how long it takes {.center .scrollable}

## Thirty minutes, most of it waiting {.scrollable}

The workshop is three hours at your own keyboard. It goes well if the data is on your machine when
you arrive, and badly if you spend the first hour downloading.

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | Re-read the five abstracts: the question, and what the data are | 10 min |
| **2** | Check the data is on your machine; download what is missing | 15 min, mostly waiting |
| **3** | Write two lines per paper, from memory | 5 min |

::: {.muted}
Everything on these slides is also on the pre-session page, `07-replication-workshop/00-pre-session/README.md`,
where the commands can be copied.
:::

## Re-read the papers {.center .scrollable}

## The five papers, and the models you will fit {.scrollable}

| # | Paper | What you will fit |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fraiberger, Lee, Puy & Ranciere (2021), *Media sentiment and international asset prices* | OLS and a binary logit |
| 2 | Amsili, van Es & Schindelbeck (2024), *Pedotransfer functions …* | OLS, its diagnostics, a squared term |
| 3 | Saganowski, Bródka, Koziarski & Kazienko (2019), *Analysis of group evolution prediction …* | binary, ordinal and multinomial logits |
| 4 | Blonigen & Piger (2014), *Determinants of foreign direct investment* | ridge, lasso, elastic net |
| 5 | Topalova & Khandelwal (2011), *Trade liberalization and firm productivity* | OLS with controls, a squared term |

::: {.step}
You read these before sessions 2 to 6. Re-read the **abstract** and the description of the
**data**: what one observation is, and what is measured.
:::

## Download what is missing {.scrollable}

::::: panel-tabset
### macOS

```bash
get() { curl -L "https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/access/dataset/:persistentId/?persistentId=doi:10.7910/DVN/$1" -o "$1.zip" && mkdir -p "$2/data/replication" && unzip -o -q "$1.zip" -d "$2/data/replication" && rm "$1.zip"; }
get QNKFJF 02-exploratory-data-analysis
get U5DAEP 03-regression-adequacy-and-validity
get ONOFS7 04-logistic-ordinal-multinomial
get 8WEXYD 06-advanced-regression
```

### Linux

```bash
get() { curl -L "https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/access/dataset/:persistentId/?persistentId=doi:10.7910/DVN/$1" -o "$1.zip" && mkdir -p "$2/data/replication" && unzip -o -q "$1.zip" -d "$2/data/replication" && rm "$1.zip"; }
get QNKFJF 02-exploratory-data-analysis
get U5DAEP 03-regression-adequacy-and-validity
get ONOFS7 04-logistic-ordinal-multinomial
get 8WEXYD 06-advanced-regression
```

No `unzip`? `sudo apt install unzip` (Debian, Ubuntu) or `sudo dnf install unzip` (Fedora).

### Windows

```powershell
function Get-Package($doi, $dir) {
  curl.exe -L "https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/access/dataset/:persistentId/?persistentId=doi:10.7910/DVN/$doi" -o "$doi.zip"
  Expand-Archive "$doi.zip" -DestinationPath "$dir\data\replication" -Force
  Remove-Item "$doi.zip"
}
Get-Package QNKFJF 02-exploratory-data-analysis
Get-Package U5DAEP 03-regression-adequacy-and-validity
Get-Package ONOFS7 04-logistic-ordinal-multinomial
Get-Package 8WEXYD 06-advanced-regression
```

Type `curl.exe`, not `curl`: in PowerShell, `curl` is a different command.
:::::

::: {.muted}
Run only the lines you need. The folders are git-ignored. If a download is refused, open the DOI in
a browser, **Access Dataset → Download ZIP**, and unzip into the same folder. Then run the check
again.
:::
